locations.name: Asterion
locations.description: Political and cultural center of the empire. Lumencia Academy is located here.

locations.name: Lumencia Academy
locations.description: The empire's most prestigious academy and a central meeting point for talented nobles and commoners. Officially politically neutral, but factions use it to recruit allies and build influence.

locations.name: Remaria
locations.description: A temperate southern coastal city known as the City of Arts, with theatre, opera, poetry, painting and magical crafts.

locations.name: Orpherum
locations.description: A southeastern port with sea markets, maritime guilds and a history associated with piracy; a Navigator Guild and Sea Temple are mentioned in the public adaptation.

locations.name: Rubelin
locations.description: A city in the northwestern plains associated with scholarship, botany, pharmacy and alchemical research.

locations.name: Prima Glacie
locations.description: A far-northern icy mountain region known for severe cold and frequent blizzards.

locations.name: Zaraha
locations.description: A southwestern desert with ancient ruins, golden temples, extreme day/night temperature changes and sandstorms.
